text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NASA-047","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N7","page":1,"quote":"MTC REPORT REQURIED NON DESTRUCTIVE TESTING (IF APPLICABLE) RAW MATERIAL UT HEAT TREATMENT DP+UT FINISH COMPOMENT MPI"}],"comment":"Note N7 requires penetrant (DP) and ultrasonic (UT) testing after heat treatment but before the finished component stage, yet no separate note instructs that this inspection must occur before finish machining. This risks the supplier performing final machining first, which would remove surface indications or make internal flaws inaccessible. Add a note explicitly stating that DP and UT inspections shall be performed prior to finish machining.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'PERFORM DP AND UT INSPECTION PRIOR TO FINISH MACHINING' to clarify the required sequence."},{"rule_id":"WF-014","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N6","page":1,"quote":"T + S NOTE : H.T.PROCESS : REF NOTE HARDNESS & DEPTH : REF NOTE FINISH & DEPTH : REF NOTE TEST COUPON SIZE : ⌀30 (20mmLENGTH - 01NOS) WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N7","page":1,"quote":"MTC REPORT REQURIED NON DESTRUCTIVE TESTING (IF APPLICABLE) RAW MATERIAL UT HEAT TREATMENT DP+UT FINISH COMPOMENT MPI"}],"comment":"Note N6 references 'WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE', but note N7 only lists generic NDT methods without tying them to weld inspection requirements for structural or lifting welds. If welding is performed, the inspector will not know what specific NDT acceptance criteria apply to the welds. Specify the required NDT method, extent, and acceptance standard for any welds made under Weld Class B.","recommended_correction":"Update the notes to state the specific NDT requirements (method, coverage, and acceptance criteria) applicable to Weld Class B welds."}]}
